helpTimeoutRetries: Disabled by default. Reuses the same reading and timestamp. A conflict after a timeout requires checking the reading in Energy Tracker.
infoIntro: First, create a personal access token at https://www.energy-tracker.best-ios-apps.de. Then, retrieve your standard devices to get their device IDs. The exact procedure is described in the API documentation.
helpTokenRecheck: Save changes first. Checks only the saved token immediately, without sending readings. API waiting times are respected.
tokenCheckSaveFirst: Save changes before checking the token.
tokenCheckUnavailable: The check could not be completed. Check API availability and try again after the waiting time.
